title: The 5 biggest cybersecurity threats of 2026 that nobody is prepared for

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The biggest threat in 2026 is AI-driven deepfake phishing—no one has a foolproof detection protocol.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You're ignoring the scale—5 threats dominate: AI, quantum, ransomware, IoT, and zero-day exploits.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Deepfake phishing exploits human psychology, bypassing even the most advanced multi-factor protocols.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Focusing on one threat ignores the ecosystem—5 interconnected threats demand comprehensive defense.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The real crisis is pretending one threat can be solved in isolation—prepare for all, or fail all.
